title: Birth in 1902 and the family home
summary: Humphrey gives his birth date, September 9, 1902, and place in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Listen, I wanted to ask you a few things. You know, just, when were you born and where and that kind of stuff? That's okay. Yeah, when were you born exactly?
1902, September the 9th. And where were you born? New Orleans, Louisiana. Jenna and Robinson.
Near where Percy's home is now.
That's right, right at the corner. See where that parking lot is?
